integrity: Original analytic proof accompanied by a standalone exact finite enumeration. The large-deviation argument is mathematical, not certified by finite tests. Historical priority has not been independently established.
scientific_limitations: One marked simplicial vertex in G(n,1-c log n/n), with c fixed and positive. No theorem about a graph conditioned to contain some simplicial vertex, arbitrary p, or global chordality; numerical checks are finite.
title: A rare-simpliciality degree transition in near-complete random graphs
